main_text.p: periores evadatis vos,vel vincatis,juxta Regia. Tremel.Et decertetis, ad Philip.1.27.
נִצְחָן, נִצְחָנָא, נִצָּחָן Ch. Victoria, triumphus: גִּבַּר נִצְחָן Vir victoriae,victoriosus,victor. Plur.נִצְחָנִין const. נִצְחָנֵי.
נִצְחוּ Syr. Victoriosus, optimus, praestantissimus, excellentissimus. Usus ejus est in compellanda persona quapiam, & respondet Graeco κεφαλὴ, Luc.1.3. Act.23.25.& 24.3.
נצל Syr. Infudit, instillavit, Lucae 10.34. Ab Hebraeo נזל. Pahel נצל Ch.Eruere,eripere, liberare, Heb. נצל. Aphel אצל Idem. Ithpahel אִתְנַצַּל Eripi, liberari, liberare se.
נצף Ch.Pipire. Pahel נצף Idem: וינצפון Et salient, saltabunt, Jesa.13.22. pro וינפצון, ut alia exemplaria habent,notante Kimchio. Hebraice dicitur צפצף.
נצץ Ch.Florere,germinare. Pahel נצץ & נצנץ Idem: Item Splendere, scintillare.
נצא, נץ Ch. Flos: Item Scintilla. Plur נצי, נצין.
נצצא Ch.Accipiter,Nisus: vel Struthiocamelus, juxta alios. Idem quod נצא, Levit.11.16. & Deuter.14.25. in Targ.Jonath.
נצר Hebr.Surculus,virgultum, germen: Plur.Ch. cum Aff. לבלבי נצרי Germina furculorum meorum, Jobi 31.8.

page.notes: Hebrew, Aramaic and Greek words are reproduced from the scan with approximate fidelity; the vocalisation of several Hebrew forms is doubtful and marked nowhere in the text. The final line נצורין is set right-aligned at the foot and may be a catchword or a line of the entry.
